title: Agenomic experiment case (v0.4)
description: One dataset entry of a prompt experiment, `agenomic.experiment_case/v1` (RFC 0012). Every member except `schema` is always present. `schema` is optional because dataset upload lines (JSONL, one case per line) omit it; the schema id always enters the hash input: `case_digest = "sha256:" + hex(sha256(canonical_json({ schema: "agenomic.experiment_case/v1", ...case })))`. Case payloads are not restricted to the Agenomic JSON Subset: `input` and `expected` may hold finite floats, so case and dataset digests are computed by the server only and clients never recompute them. A case is at most 256 KiB of canonical JSON, and `case_id` is unique within a dataset version; neither rule is expressible here. Kind `prompt_variables` is accepted by this schema and refused when an experiment is launched.
